threats.title: Contractor Impersonation
threats.description: An attacker may impersonate being a new contractor / a different branch of an existing contractor
threats.mitigation: Enforcing identity verification before registering a new client and allowing him to send job requests

threats.title: Contractor Info Leakage
threats.description: Compromised device may be exploited by attacker for info gathering
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Account Spoofing
threats.description: An attacker may manage to hijack user sessions (may schedule unwanted / incorrect prints).
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Path Traversal
threats.description: If web portal not well implemented, may expose some information to non authorized actors
threats.mitigation: Develop a well engineered web portal that only shows proper information to the client

threats.title: CSRF
threats.description: If the contractor disables safety features or uses outdated browser versions it may be vulnerable to CSRF
threats.mitigation: Deny access if old browser is used

threats.title: Portal Overload
threats.description: By spamming automated requests to the portal, it might be overloaded with too many requests thus making the portal unreachable for legitimate users
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Obtaining admin access
threats.description: If an attacker manages to gain admin access via a vulnerability on the portal or via compromising an admin account he can manage accounts and the level of privilege they have, private information, and much more
threats.mitigation: Ensure multi factor authentication or admin access possible only if directly connected to the server in the factory building

threats.title: Powder Management Tampering
threats.description: Modify powder information and requests

threats.title: Thermal Sensor Tampering
threats.description: Intercepting and modifying information about the temperature of the printers, makes the printers not stop when temperature is too high, causing production of brittle metal.

threats.title: Quality Control Tampering
threats.description: Alter the outcome of quality control process to store an invalid print as a valid one
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Forging Requests
threats.description: It is possible to forge requests or modify the legitimate requests to affect the production line
threats.mitigation: Encrypted Communication

threats.title: Slicer Spoofing
threats.description: An attacker, after leaking the API key, can communicate directly with the MES (printers) impersonating the Slicer Server and scheduling non requested jobs.
threats.mitigation: No longer use hardcoded API key (TODO)

threats.title: Slicer Server Overloading
threats.description: The conversion process is resource-expensive, it is possible to forge requests and overload the slicer server to slow down significantly the production speed or to crash the server completely
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Slicer Server Compromization
threats.description: If a vulnerability or bug is unmitigated an attacker might exploit it to gain control of the slicer server and completely change the conversions from CAD to G-code making unnoticeable damages
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: MES Overload
threats.description: An attacker connected to the ethernet network can overload the MES thus slowing down/halting production
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: MES Spoofing
threats.description: Impersonating the MES and scheduling prints to the various printers due to unauthenticated unencrypted communication
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Old OS known vulnerabilities
threats.description: The printers have old OS systems that have known vulnerabilities that might be exploited
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: EoP via known vulnerabilities
threats.description: due to the old windows XP OS, some known vulnerabilities can be exploited to gain root privileges and compromise the printer or other systems
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Stop Powder Resupply
threats.description: Attackers can target the resupply system and either stop the resupply or completely dump the powder stock
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Thermal Sensor Spoofing
threats.description: Sending forged packets with wrong information about the temperature of the printers, makes the printers not stop when temperature is too high, causing production of brittle metal.

threats.title: Sensor Reading Modification
threats.description: an attacker can modify the readings of the sensors, sending the crafted ones not making the printer realize of the high temperature

threats.title: Sensor activity disruption
threats.description: Disrupting the sensors by sending commands to interfere with the correct functioning, ex: turning off the sensors prematurely
